verdict.rationale: Pigment's Analyst Agent is described as one that "continuously monitors your business, uncovers what matters," and variance analysis can "flag the reasons behind identified gaps." That points toward proactive detection of metrics moving against plan, but nothing documents that it pushes alerts to the user unprompted. The email/Slack notifications shown are only for manual @-tagging of colleagues, an adjacent collaboration feature that does not earn credit here. Missing for 10: documented threshold or variance-to-plan alerting delivered to the user, reporting-deadline reminders, configuration of alert channels for metric triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
